text:
deploybot: AUTO-QUARANTINE: canary deploy 2026.03.18-rc4 blocked
deploybot: reason=SBOM signing chain mismatch for image gcr.io/redwood-prod/service-a:2026.03.18-rc4, sig.kid != expected_kid

oliver: @tina fyi — canary is quarantined, saw the deploybot alert. any idea on the signature mismatch? :eyes:

tina: I pulled the image and ran cosign verify-local, got this error: 
```
Verification for gcr.io/redwood-prod/service-a:2026.03.18-rc4 FAILED
error: signature uses key id projects/redwood-prod/locations/us/keyRings/release/cryptoKeys/release-sign-v2
expected key id: projects/redwood-prod/locations/us/keyRings/release/cryptoKeys/release-sign
```

jake: hmm looks like a key rotation happened last week during the nightly rotation job. Shouldn't kube-deploy have used the old key for existing artifacts?

maria: deploy pipeline used the manifest built on 2026-03-17 22:03 UTC. That builder still used release-sign-v2 — but our RBAC for signing was updated. Not sure how the mismatch surfaced only on canary.

oliver: Options: 1) Pin to previous image digest (safe rollback), 2) Re-sign artifact with expected key (requires release-secrets access + audit), 3) Request exception to unquarantine while we investigate.

security-bot: TODO: Create audit ticket if re-sign chosen. Any re-sign requires KMS approval and 2 approvers from security and release.

emma: For customer-facing workloads I'd prefer rollback to last good digest and re-run build under CI with current key. That avoids tampering risk.

tina: Agree. Can we get the last good digest? I have digest from staging: sha256:9b7f2a1c6d4f3e8a2b... (truncated)

jake: I can open the rollback PR and pin manifest to that digest. But note: the change window closes at 23:00 UTC. If we want to cut a hotfix before window, need approval now.

oliver: @maria can you confirm the staging digest is identical to what prod previously ran? We should avoid divergence.

maria: Confirmed — last successful prod deploy on 2026-03-16 used the same digest. Good to pin.

oliver: Ok proceeding with plan A (pin+rollforward to pinned digest): @jake please open PR and target canary rollback. Include release note entry: "canary blocked due to SBOM signature key mismatch; rolling back to previous verified image digest while we investigate key rotation."

jake: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service-a/pull/482 -- includes manifest pin and rollback instructions. cc @oliver @tina
deploybot: NOTE: unquarantine requires the deploybot command `deploybot unquarantine --thread 1745003210 --approved-by oliver,jake` and will trigger a redeploy.

security-bot: @oliver please confirm if we want to raise an exception for monitoring-only canary unquarantine (risk: bypass signature verification). Audit required if approved.

oliver: Not at this time. Rollback first. We'll do a root-cause postmortem and coordinate key rotation audit.

maria: I'll schedule a quick postmortem doc and add the rotation timeline. Also tagging infra: @infra-team for rotation policy review.

tina: After rollback lands, I'll run cosign verify against the pinned digest and attach the verification output to the PR.

emma: Small note for release notes: please include the mitigation and that no customer data was affected. Keep wording: "infrastructure signing inconsistency"

jake: Rolling back now — deploying pinned digest to canary. Will post status. :rocket:

deploybot: ACTION: canary rollback started by jake at 1745003612, job=deploy-canary-service-a, trace=deploy-7364

deploybot: SUCCESS: canary rollback completed at 1745003789, artifact pinned to sha256:9b7f2a1c6d4f3e8a2b...

tina: Verified: cosign verify output shows valid chain with expected key id: projects/redwood-prod/locations/us/keyRings/release/cryptoKeys/release-sign

oliver: Thanks everyone. I'll mark this thread for the postmortem and add to release risk notes. We'll require a formal key-rotation runbook update before next deployment. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: Audit ticket created: AUDIT-2026-3316 (re-signing-exception/risk-review)

maria: Filed postmortem draft at https://confluence.redwood.ai/x/pmR9 — feel free to add notes.

emma: Adding to release notes: "Canary briefly quarantined due to SBOM signature chain mismatch; rolled back to verified image. Investigation ongoing; no impact to customers."

oliver: Closing thread once docs updated. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
